lines.text: Stitches told me you remembered his favorite dish. He talks about you like you hung the moon, dear.
Stitches told me you said "[last_rude_line]". He was really hurt by it, dear. You didn't mean it, did you?

choices.text: I didn't. I feel awful. I'll make it right.
choices.reply: I knew it. Tell him yourself, he'll forgive you in a heartbeat.

choices.text: I was having a bad day.
choices.reply: We all do. But he's had more bad days than most.

lines.text: Cheddar says you're his favorite chef here. He told me three times. He's never said that about anyone, dear.
My friend Cheddar told me you said "[last_rude_line]". He made a joke about it, but I know that boy. He was really hurt by it. You didn't mean it, did you?

choices.text: I didn't. I'll tell him I'm sorry.
choices.reply: Good. He acts like nothing gets to him. Everything gets to him.

choices.text: He laughed, so I thought it was fine.
choices.reply: Oh, dear. He always laughs. That's how you know.
...Well. I'll be eating somewhere quieter for a while.

lines.text: Mabel says you're her favorite chef here. ...I told her I said it first.
Mabel told me you made her soup without her even asking. She said, 'That one pays attention.' ...She's right. You do.
Mabel said you were short with her yesterday. That's not like you. ...Is everything okay?

choices.text: I wasn't fair to her. I'll make it right.
choices.reply: Okay. Good. She'd never say it, but she'd like that.

lines.text: Mabel didn't say anything bad about you. She never would. But she was quiet. She's never quiet. ...Did something happen?

choices.text: I wasn't fair to her. I'll make it right.
choices.reply: Okay. Good. She'd never say it, but she'd like that.

lines.text: Cheddar told me you made him laugh so hard he snorted. He made me promise not to tell anyone. ...I'm only telling you.
Cheddar said you told him "[last_rude_line]". He said it was fine. ...I don't think it was fine. You didn't mean it, did you?

choices.text: I didn't. I'll apologize to him.
choices.reply: Okay. ...He'll act like it's no big deal. It is, though. Thank you.
He laughs everything off. That's kind of the problem.

lines.text: Grandma Mabel says you sat with her for, like, ten minutes yesterday. You're making the rest of us look bad.
Hey. Grandma Mabel told me you said "[last_rude_line]". ...She's like a hundred. She was really hurt by it. You didn't mean it, did you?

choices.reply: Good. Bring soup. Soup fixes Grandma.
...She's ninety-one. She doesn't have time to 'get over it.'

lines.text: Hey. Mabel told me what you said to her. ...Not cool. She's like a hundred. Be nice to her.

choices.reply: Good. Bring soup. Soup fixes Grandma.
...She's ninety-one. She doesn't have time to 'get over it.'

lines.text: Stitches says you're the only chef who remembers how he likes his pancakes. He was smiling about it. Stitches. Smiling. In public.
Did you say something to Stitches? He's been quiet. Like, quieter. ...Fix it.

choices.reply: He's my friend. So now it's between me too.
